m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You find the Sky Hook and take it. This relic will allow you to navigate the Zip Lines of the Floating Mountains. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Again there are signs of a scuffle. Morganthe's forces cannot help but leave a trail of destruction. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You think you hear sounds of conflict, but the Pampero Spirits are making a tremendous racket. Maybe if you "quelled" a few. </ITALICS>
The Shadow dragged the Jaguar Oracle into the Oracle's Cave. It should be her Place of Power, but they have wounded her.
<ITALICS>There, you heard a cry for help! It came from that Cave! </ITALICS>
Your persistence surprises even me! But I cannot let you detain me.
The Oracle revealed that I need this Crystal Skull to find the Horn of Huracan.
So I'll just take the Crystal Skull, and leave you two steps behind, as always!
I'll crack your bones and slake my thirst, and earn a great commendation from the Shadow Queen!
I knew you would come for me. Please, help me outside?
Use it to sail across the sky to the Isla Major, where you will find the Oracle's home. Find her and help her against the Shadow!
With the New Day Charm, Belloq and the Shadow Queen can force the Oracle to help them! You must help her!
I cannot undo the damage I've done, but let me do what I can. Go to my tent. Outside, you'll find a Sky Hook. Take it.
The Sky Hook will let you travel up and down the magical Zip Lines.
Get the Sky Hook near my tent, and use it to cross over to Isla Major. Find the Oracle and help her resist the Shadow!
